title: Stalks of the intersection ideal of a compatible affine cover
statement: Let Y be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U an affine open, and (V_i) an arbitrary indexed family of affine opens contained in U and covering U. For each i let J_i be an ideal of Gamma(Y,V_i). Assume for each z in V_i intersect V_j that the extensions of J_i and J_j along their germ maps into O(Y,z) are equal. Put L = intersection_i res_{U,V_i}^{-1}(J_i), an ideal of Gamma(Y,U). Then for every i and z in V_i the extension of L along the germ map Gamma(Y,U) to O(Y,z) equals the extension of J_i along Gamma(Y,V_i) to O(Y,z).

source.place: Tag 01HR, lemma-affine-sheaves; Tag 01I6, lemma-compare-constructions; Tag 01LA, locality of quasi-coherence; Tag 0BVH, local determinant ideal construction

proof.text: Associate to each inclusion J_i in Gamma(V_i) its quasi-coherent subsheaf of the structure sheaf on V_i. Exactness of localization makes the inclusion injective and identifies its stalk with the extension ideal of J_i. Equality of the stalk submodules on overlaps identifies the subsheaves there: membership locally at every point implies membership of a section by the sheaf axiom. The identity identifications satisfy the cocycle condition and glue to a subsheaf K on U. Quasi-coherence is local, hence K is quasi-coherent.

The affine tilde/global-sections equivalence identifies K with the sheaf associated to L = K(U), viewed as an ideal in Gamma(U). A section of Gamma(U) belongs to K(U) exactly when every restriction belongs to J_i, by the sheaf gluing and uniqueness axioms. Thus L is the intersection of the inverse images of J_i, including redundant charts and arbitrary indexing.

The stalk of K at z equals the localization of L, whose image inside O(Y,z) is L extended along the germ map. Restrict K to V_i to compute the same stalk as the extension of J_i. The equality of the two stalk submodules is the conclusion. If U or the index set is empty, the point premise is impossible; ideals zero and top and repeated charts are allowed. No arbitrary witness is chosen in a definition.

theorem affineCoverIdeal_map_germ
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (U : Y.affineOpens)
    {ι : Type v} (V : ι → Y.affineOpens) (hV : ∀ i, (V i).1 ≤ U.1)
    (J : ∀ i, Ideal Γ(Y, (V i).1))
    (hcover : ∀ y : Y, y ∈ U.1 → ∃ i, y ∈ (V i).1)
    (hcompat : ∀ i j (y : Y) (hi : y ∈ (V i).1) (hj : y ∈ (V j).1),
      (J i).map (Y.presheaf.germ (V i).1 y hi).hom =
        (J j).map (Y.presheaf.germ (V j).1 y hj).hom)
    (i : ι) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ (V i).1) :
    (⨅ j, (J j).comap (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV j)).op).hom).map
        (Y.presheaf.germ U.1 y (hV i hy)).hom =
      (J i).map (Y.presheaf.germ (V i).1 y hy).hom
